text: {"lessons":["Selling winners has felt rewarding, but a gain relative to my cost is not by itself a reason to sell; I should judge the choice by its role in my overall portfolio.","I should not keep a losing position merely to avoid admitting a mistake, or sell a winner just to lock in a gain; neither purchase price nor the emotional comfort of realizing a result predicts what comes next.","This short record and random price movements cannot reliably forecast future returns, so I should trade infrequently and make decisions based on diversification and risk rather than recent performance."]}
